meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能助手具备部署网站的能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能自动把网站发布上线
copy.tagline_en: Enable your assistant to deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to deploy websites for you

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会获得部署网站到 Vercel 的能力：自动安装 Vercel 命令行工具、配置访问令牌、更新容器镜像并同步给现有 agent 组，之后可执行 vercel 命令。
howto.when: 当用户想让 Claude 把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。

say.text: 把项目部署到 Vercel 的生产环境。
say.note: 会执行生产部署，可能需要提供访问令牌。

say.text: 列出我最近的 Vercel 部署。
say.note: 会调用 vercel ls 显示部署记录。

say.text: 给 agent 加上 Vercel 部署能力。
say.note: 会安装 CLI 并配置凭证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains the ability to deploy web apps to Vercel. It installs the Vercel CLI, configures access tokens, updates container images, and syncs skills to existing agent groups. It can then run vercel commands for deployment and listing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants Claude to deploy a web application to Vercel.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Triggers a production deploy; may ask for an access token.
Runs vercel ls to show deployment records.

say_en.text: Add Vercel deployment capability to agents.
say_en.note: Installs the CLI and configures credentials.
